channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Sem citar Flávio, Tarcísio chama Lula de ultrapassado e defende renovação
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas criticized President Lula, calling him an 'aged and outdated' leader with nothing left to offer, and called for political renewal. Although he did not directly mention Flávio Bolsonaro, his remarks align with the opposition's discourse against the federal government. The statement was made amid growing polarization between the São Paulo state government and the federal executive.

item.title: Sem citar Lula, Tarcísio diz que há ‘lideranças envelhecidas’ que não percebem a hora de parar
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that there are 'aged leaderships' in Brazil that fail to recognize it's time to step aside and allow for renewal, without directly naming President Lula. He emphasized the need for political renewal and acknowledged that he too will one day have to leave office.

item.title: O lugar de Flávio Bolsonaro na história de truques e estelionatos eleitorais do Brasil
item.description: The article discusses Flávio Bolsonaro's role in electoral fraud schemes in Brazil, comparing him to historical practices of political and financial manipulation, such as those seen during the Collor government. It suggests that Bolsonaro is part of a tradition of using illegal tactics to gain electoral advantage, linking this to concerns about asset confiscation and economic instability.

item.title: Moro e Flávio aparecem juntos pela 1ª vez em vídeo do PL
item.description: The Paraná branch of the Liberal Party (PL) released a video featuring the first joint appearance of Flávio Bolsonaro and Sergio Moro, the party's pre-candidates for president and governor of Paraná, alongside Filipe Barros. The ad emphasizes the party's growth in the state, pledges to protect Paraná and oppose 'petists and criminals', and reinforces a hardline stance against the left and corruption. Moro, who left União Brasil to join the PL in March 2026 after conflicts with the PP, seeks to rebrand himself as a loyal Bolsonaro ally following his contentious resignation from the federal government in 2020.

item.title: PT recorre a nomes históricos para puxar voto para a Câmara
item.description: The PT is turning to historical figures such as José Dirceu, João Paulo Cunha, and Delúbio Soares to strengthen its presence in the Chamber of Deputies in 2026, betting on their experience and national recognition. Dirceu is running for a federal deputy seat in São Paulo after his convictions were annulled, Cunha left the private sector to return to politics with direct support from Lula, and Delúbio Soares is running again in Goiás after recovering his political rights, stating he would make the same choices again despite the Mensalão scandal.

item.title: Carlos Bolsonaro fala em 'oportunistas' após critica de Nikolas Ferreira: 'Brasil merece mais'
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro (PL-SC) criticized fellow bolsonarists as 'opportunists' for not promoting his brother Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, asserting that political loyalty should not be based on convenience. He emphasized that the movement must uphold its principles and that Brazil deserves better than current internal divisions. The remarks follow a public exchange with Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG), who argued that electoral success comes from substantive ideas and effort, not merely social media activity.

item.title: Lideranças do agronegócio criticam fim da escala 6x1 na abertura da Expozebu
item.description: Agribusiness leaders criticized the Lula government's proposal to end the 6x1 work schedule during the opening of Expozebu in Uberaba, MG. They argue the change could harm productivity and workers' rights in rural areas.

item.title: Eleições 2026: após atrito entre Nikolas e Jair Renan, Flávio Bolsonaro pede unidade da direita
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) called for unity on the right following tensions between Nikolas Ferreira and Jair Renan Bolsonaro, urging cohesion among Bolsonaro allies ahead of the 2026 elections. He published an appeal to the base, criticizing internal provocations that weaken the conservative camp.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede fim de cobranças entre aliados do PL
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) called for an end to provocations among Bolsonarist allies after exchanges of insults between Nikolas Ferreira and Jair Renan Bolsonaro. He emphasized that support must be earned, not imposed, and that each person contributes at their own pace, stressing the need for unity to win the 2026 elections.

item.title: “Tá na hora de largar o osso e sair”, diz Tarcísio sobre Lula
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas criticized Brazil's aging political leadership without naming names directly, calling for renewal and suggesting some leaders fail to recognize when it's time to step down. Although he did not explicitly mention Lula in the excerpt, the post's title associates his remarks with a critique of the president, implying Lula is among those referenced. The comments were made during an event in Monteiro Lobato, in the countryside of São Paulo.

item.title: A preocupação da equipe de Flávio Bolsonaro com os amigos de Michelle
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign team attributes tensions with Michelle Bolsonaro to her close associates, particularly makeup artist Agustín Fernández, who publicly criticized Flávio and predicted his defeat. They fear such comments damage Flávio's image in polls, where he is already tied with Lula in a potential runoff. Strategists warn Michelle would harm her own Senate bid if she refuses to support Flávio, as he could challenge her loyalty to the PL party.

item.title: Pastor evangélico atua por Jorge Messias no Senado
item.description: Evangelical pastor William Douglas has become a key political operative for Jorge Messias, lobbying conservative and right-wing senators to support Messias’ nomination to the Supreme Federal Court. According to allies, his outreach to over 70 of the 81 senators has helped smooth the path ahead of the April 29 confirmation hearing. Messias also has backing from figures such as STF Minister André Mendonça and prominent evangelical leaders.

item.title: Ciro Gomes defende “ruptura” contra polarização no país
item.description: Ciro Gomes (PSDB) stated that Brazil faces a structural and historical crisis, advocating for a 'rupture' in the country rather than merely selecting a presidential candidate. He highlighted high interest rates, low growth, and high household and corporate debt as obstacles to development, criticizing polarization for distracting from real problems. Ciro said he is evaluating a 2026 candidacy and will decide by May, focusing on concrete economic proposals.

item.title: Ciro Gomes leva a política para longe dos extremos, diz Paulo Serra
item.description: Paulo Serra, national vice-president of the PSDB, endorsed Ciro Gomes as a alternative to overcome political polarization in Brazil, stating the former governor could take politics 'away from the extremes' and engage with diverse sectors. Serra criticized voters for choosing 'to avoid the worst' and said he is available to run for governor of São Paulo if called upon by the party.

item.title: Briga com Gilmar rende tração a Zema nas redes sociais, diz levantamento
item.description: The public dispute between Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes and former governor Romeu Zema significantly boosted Zema’s social media presence, gaining over 494,000 new followers according to Bites consultancy. The controversy indirectly benefited the Novo Party’s presidential pre-candidate, increasing his digital traction.

item.title: Mirando a reeleição, Lula acena com dinheiro e concessões aos evangélicos
item.description: The federal government has been granting benefits to evangelical churches, including land donations for temples, funding for religious events, and use of public facilities, in an effort to improve relations with this electoral segment. Despite these measures, Lula’s disapproval among evangelicals reached 68% according to a Genial/Quaest poll, the highest since July 2023. Opposition leaders doubt these concessions will reverse the growing rejection.

item.title: Decido até maio, diz Ciro Gomes sobre disputar a Presidência
item.description: Ciro Gomes said he will decide by May whether to run for president in 2026, depending on whether he sees a viable political project capable of breaking polarization. He emphasized he does not want to be elected only to disappoint voters, stating Brazil needs a project, not just a candidate. Although honored by the invitation from PSDB leader Aécio Neves, Ciro stressed the decision requires caution and that he will continue contributing to national political debate.

item.title: Lula leva Camilo Santana para conversa com empresários sobre a eleição presidencial
item.description: Lula took Camilo Santana to a private meeting with education sector entrepreneurs in Brasília, where the former minister spoke as a potential presidential candidate, indicating he would face Flávio Bolsonaro in August. Lula signaled that Camilo will have 'new flights' in national politics, will not run for governor of Ceará, and will travel the country to establish himself as the PT's post-Lula figure. The meeting reinforces Camilo's positioning as Lula's natural successor should the president decline to run for re-election.

item.title: DESENCARNE EM MASSA DE POLITICOS: A QUEDA DE LULA E A VITORIA DE FLÁVIO BOLSONARO | CIGANO IAGO
item.description: The video titled 'DESENCARNE EM MASSA DE POLITICOS: A QUEDA DE LULA E A VITORIA DE FLÁVIO BOLSONARO | CIGANO IAGO' suggests a narrative of Lula's decline and Flávio Bolsonaro's victory in the 2026 elections, though the displayed content is generic and lacks substantive information about campaigns, policies, or real events. The absence of concrete data indicates the material may be speculative, sensationalist, or decontextualized.

item.title: Sem 6 X 1, comércio “vai poder contratar folguista”, diz Boulos
item.description: Minister Guilherme Boulos stated that ending the 6X1 work schedule will allow businesses to hire 'substitute workers' for weekends, ensuring that bakeries, malls, and gas stations remain open. He emphasized that Lula’s bill to reduce the workweek to 40 hours guarantees two days of rest. However, Boulos did not mention the potential increase in labor costs from hiring substitutes, which could be passed on to consumers.

item.title: IA, influenciadores, posts nas redes: o que diz a lei sobre campanha eleitoral
item.description: Influencers may engage in electoral speech only as spontaneous citizen expression, without receiving money, benefits, or content boosting. The ban includes direct and indirect payments, such as prizes in 'cutting contests', prohibited by the TSE in 2026. Candidates and parties may boost content, but only with transparency and within electoral rules.

item.title: Tereza Cristina mantém porta aberta para vice, mas prioriza presidência do Senado
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) states she has not received a formal invitation to be Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate but leaves the door open for party negotiations. Her main goal is to run for Senate presidency in 2027, aiming to become the first woman to lead the chamber. She supports impeaching STF ministers and is seen as a candidate appealing to the Centrão and agribusiness, though facing resistance from hardline Bolsonarists.

item.title: Cotado para o Senado em São Paulo, André do Prado quer Eduardo Bolsonaro de suplente
item.description: André do Prado, president of the São Paulo Legislative Assembly and ally of Valdemar Costa Neto, is negotiating to be the Senate candidate on Tarcísio de Freitas's ticket, with Eduardo Bolsonaro as a potential alternate. He stated the decision will be made within 15 days and the announcement will be made by Eduardo Bolsonaro. Eduardo Bolsonaro's potential candidacy carries legal risks due to the cassation of his mandate for absences and an ongoing STF case alleging coercion in the course of proceedings.

item.title: A esperança de Bolsonaro no STM
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro is seeking to avoid losing his captain's rank in the Superior Military Court (STM) by submitting documentation of his military career and decorations to argue that his conduct as an officer was compatible with Armed Forces values, despite his STF conviction for attempting a coup. The strategy aims to emphasize that his military honor preceded his political career, countering allegations of involvement in a bomb plot at military barracks nearly four decades ago. Rapporteur Minister Carlos Vuyk de Aquino is considering these elements to assess the 'ethical and moral conditions of the officer,' a decisive factor for the potential sanction under law for convictions exceeding two years.

item.title: PT gasta ao menos R$ 147 mil com ofensiva contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PT spent at least R$146,900 in April to boost six videos criticizing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro on Facebook and Instagram, reaching over 18 million views. The campaign seeks to associate the pre-candidate with negative themes such as U.S. criticism of Pix, the Banco Master case, the Iran war, rising fuel prices, and the label of 'sellout'. The PL has filed six actions with the TSE demanding content removal and fines for illegal early negative propaganda, totaling R$4.18 million.

item.title: Carlos Bolsonaro fala em "oportunistas" após briga com Nikolas Ferreira
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro (PL-SC) accused political groups of being 'opportunists' after a public clash with deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG), stating that the essence of Bolsonarism cannot be lost due to internal criticism. He said he will continue fighting for the country's freedom, like his father Jair Bolsonaro and the 'political prisoners'. The dispute occurs amid demands for greater engagement in the pre-campaign of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-SP) for presidency, led by Carlos and Eduardo Bolsonaro.

item.title: Ação com 200 PMs e 3 helicópteros prende 1 por roubo "quebra-vidro"
item.description: A São Paulo Military Police conducted a large-scale operation with 200 officers, three helicopters, and drones, monitoring 126 locations, resulting in the arrest of a single suspect linked to the 'glass-breaking' gang. The 24-year-old suspect, apprehended in Vila Andrade after a tip, admitted to using an automotive candle to shatter car windows and was located with helicopter assistance in a wooded area.

item.title: Defensoria contesta decisão de Moraes e aponta falhas em caso Tagliaferro
item.description: The Federal Public Defender's Office (DPU) appealed a ruling by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes that compelled it to assume the defense of Eduardo Tagliaferro, a former aide of the justice at the Superior Electoral Court. The DPU challenges the manner of its designation in the case, citing procedural irregularities and asserting flaws in the judicial decision.

item.title: Reforma do Judiciário em debate
item.description: The debate on judiciary reform gains momentum following a proposal by Minister Flávio Dino, but the STF prefers to postpone it until after the 2026 elections due to an unfavorable political climate. Presidential pre-candidates discuss reforms such as fixed terms for STF justices and stricter rules on relatives of magistrates, while the TSE addresses electoral issues, including voting rights of provisional detainees and proportionality in sanctions for racial quota fund misuse.

item.title: Flávio e Silas Malafaia se encontram em agenda evangélica no Rio para selar a paz
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro will meet with pastor Silas Malafaia in Rio de Janeiro on May 3 to officially secure evangelical support for his presidential candidacy and reconcile after months of criticism. The meeting will take place at a service of the Assembleia de Deus - Vitória em Cristo, strengthening the alliance between the PL party and evangelical leaders, as polls show Flávio with 48% preference among evangelicals — double that of Lula.

item.title: Alvo de críticas por admitir desconexão de Lula com jovens, presidente da UNE diz que não fez ataque
item.description: UNE president Bianca Borges denied attacking President Lula after facing criticism for saying his government is disconnected from youth. She clarified her interview aimed to highlight the challenges of political debate in the digital age, marked by polarization and misinformation, and reaffirmed her support for Lula’s re-election.

item.title: Governo Lula associa bets ao endividamento: entenda por que especialistas questionam essa ligação
item.description: The Lula government has intensified its criticism of betting houses ('bets'), linking them to household indebtedness, although experts debate this link, arguing that expensive credit and low financial literacy are more decisive factors. While data shows betting spending (R$ 37 bi in 2025) is lower than spending on alcoholic beverages and streaming, studies like Claudio Felisoni's from FIA suggest gambling weighs twice as much as interest rates and credit supply in indebtedness. The debate unfolds amid rising gambling addiction, with increased SUS treatment access and constitutional challenges to the sports betting law in the STF.

item.title: Nikolas x Bolsonaros: veja a escalada da troca de acusações entre o deputado e a família do ex-presidente
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) escalated his conflict with the Bolsonaro family, accusing allies of the clan of creating division and persecuting fellow party members who do not sufficiently promote Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy. He called Jair Renan Bolsonaro a 'blind mole' and argued that winning votes requires real work, intelligence, and preparation—not just social media posts. The feud, ongoing for years, has previously involved clashes with Eduardo and Carlos Bolsonaro, particularly during the 2024 municipal elections.

item.title: Lula: “Partido que está no governo não corre atrás do adversário”
item.description: Lula stated in a video message to the PT's 8th Congress that governing parties should focus on delivering concrete results, not chasing opponents. He criticized opposition strategies based on personal attacks and emphasized the need to govern with a focus on tangible achievements.

item.title: Pacote de Lula contra dívidas deve incluir débitos do Fies
item.description: The Lula government is preparing a new phase of the Desenrola program to include Fies student debt, responding to the president’s public call. The measure aims to renegotiate debts of low-income students, with an average of R$ 46,000 per delinquent borrower and a total of R$ 93.8 billion in active contracts. The initiative also includes countermeasures, such as restricting digital betting, to prevent beneficiaries from falling back into debt cycles.

item.title: A captura do Estado e o interesse dos mais pobres
item.description: Lula criticizes the left that uses progressive rhetoric while practicing fiscal austerity, claiming it amounts to succumbing to neoliberalism. He argues that quality public policies do not require spending cuts, but rather ending the state’s capture by elites who divert public funds through overpaid positions, campaign financing, and illegal official flights, as shown in a TCU report. The author contends that real austerity means fighting this waste, not reducing social investment.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aparece à frente de Lula no RJ, aponta pesquisa
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro leads President Lula in a hypothetical second-round runoff in Rio de Janeiro, with 47% voting intention versus 40.5% for the president, according to Paraná Pesquisas. In the first-round simulation, both candidates are in a technical tie within the margin of error. The poll was released on Saturday, the 25th.

item.title: Nikolas critica capacidade cognitiva de Jair Renan: “Toupeira cega”
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) criticized the cognitive capacity of councilman Jair Renan Bolsonaro (PL-SC), son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, comparing it to that of a 'blind mole' in a post on X. The comment followed an exchange between Jair Renan and influencer Vlog do Lisboa, who also launched personal attacks against Nikolas. The incident is part of a broader pattern of infighting within Brazil's right-wing, involving Eduardo Bolsonaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who recently called for unity and rationality among conservative leaders.

item.title: PT retira menções ao caso Master de manifesto
item.description: The PT removed references to the Banco Master case and former President Jair Bolsonaro from its 'Building the Future' manifesto, following a request from the Planalto Palace. The original text linked the scandal involving Daniel Vorcaro to the current government, but the change aims to avoid controversy ahead of the party's 8th Congress in Brasília.

item.title: O prazo do Planalto para o encontro entre Lula e Trump
item.description: Lula’s government is assessing the likelihood of a meeting between the Brazilian president and Donald Trump, with expectations that it could happen by July, before the October re-election campaign begins. After that point, Lula’s international agenda is expected to be constrained by electoral commitments. The previously cordial relationship between the two leaders is now under scrutiny due to Lula’s increasingly critical tone toward Trump, including ironic remarks about the U.S. president potentially receiving a Nobel Prize.

item.title: Governo Lula desiste de uso do FGTS para abater dívidas de famílias
item.description: The federal government abandoned the proposal to use FGTS funds to pay off household debts, shifting focus to a new phase of the Desenrola program aimed at debt renegotiation. The decision follows criticism and economic impact assessments of using the severance fund for this purpose.

item.title: Direita vê embate com o STF como trunfo para a eleição; Lula adota cautela
item.description: The Brazilian right is leveraging its confrontation with the Supreme Federal Court as an electoral strategy, with pre-candidates like Flávio Bolsonaro and Romeu Zema attacking ministers and alleging electoral interference. Meanwhile, the Lula government adopts caution, testing a discourse on judicial reform to contain the escalation. The clash, fueled by investigations such as the Fake News Inquiry, deepens political polarization five months ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Como as terras raras entraram na discussão eleitoral de 2026
item.description: The debate over Brazil's rare earths entered the 2026 electoral campaign following the sale of miner Serra Verde to U.S. interests, orchestrated by Ronaldo Caiado (PSD). The opposition, especially Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), is using the issue to accuse the Lula government of being 'anti-American', while promising to expand mineral exploration in partnership with the U.S. Brazil holds the world's second-largest rare earth reserves, critical for technology, defense, and automotive industries, but risks losing added value and sovereignty by focusing only on raw extraction.

item.title: Flávio tem 47% contra 40,5% de Lula entre eleitores do RJ
item.description: A Paraná Pesquisas survey conducted April 21–23, 2026, among Rio de Janeiro voters shows Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) would defeat President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in a hypothetical runoff, 47% to 40.5%. In a first-round scenario, the candidates are technically tied within the margin of error (39.6% vs. 36.7%). The poll also indicates 55.2% of Rio voters disapprove of the Lula government's performance.

item.title: A exemplo da oposição, PT resolve pegar carona eleitoreira na impopularidade do STF
item.description: The PT is leveraging the Supreme Court's unpopularity, especially regarding the Banco Master scandal, to gain electoral ground in 2026. Lula reportedly advised Minister Alexandre de Moraes to recuse himself from cases involving his wife, whose law firm had a R$129 million contract with the liquidated bank — a move interpreted as electorally motivated to distance the government from the scandal. The party announced it will propose an ethics code for STF ministers, following the opposition’s strategy of exploiting the Judiciary’s legitimacy crisis as a central electoral theme.

item.title: A honra em jogo: o "aspone" de Trump e o escarro contra as brasileiras
item.description: Donald Trump's envoy, Paolo Zampolli, insulted Brazilian women by calling them a 'race programmed to cause chaos' and 'prostitutes,' sparking national outrage and criticism over the use of free speech as a shield for hate. His continued tenure without consequences from the Itamaraty or the U.S. government is seen as complicity in hate speech and dehumanization. The article warns that the acceptance of such insults by some Brazilians reflects a dangerous erosion of national pride and collective dignity.

item.title: 10 dos 12 pré-candidatos à Presidência já se manifestaram contra o STF
item.description: Out of 12 presidential pre-candidates tested in electoral polls, 10 have publicly expressed opposition to the actions of the Supreme Federal Court in 2026. Criticisms center on alleged judicial activism, the January 8 case, purported links between justices and the Master Bank, and rulings seen as harmful to the country, such as the Ferrogrão decision. Romeu Zema (Novo) stands out for intensifying confrontations with ministers like Gilmar Mendes and Alexandre de Moraes, using social media to attack their decisions.

item.title: Paraná Pesquisas: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 39,6% e Lula, 36,7%, no Rio
item.description: Paraná Pesquisas shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) leading presidential vote intentions for 2026 in Rio de Janeiro with 39.6%, followed by Lula (PT) at 36.7%. In a potential runoff, Bolsonaro would have 47% versus Lula's 40.5%. The survey also finds 55.2% of Rio voters disapprove of Lula's government, with 38.1% rating it 'terrible'.

item.title: Coluna da Tribuna: A posição de Rodolfo
item.description: Following the removal of Guto Silva as the PSD's candidate for governor of Paraná, Apucarana's mayor Rodolfo Mota (União Brasil) is emerging as a potential contender in the state race. His position gains relevance in the state political landscape, particularly after Silva's departure from the PSD.

item.title: Nikolas diz a Flávio que sofre provocações há 3 anos e cita clima “que ninguém mais suporta”
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) said he has endured provocations for three years and criticized the current political climate as unbearable, noting he has a personal limit amid mutual accusations with Bolsonarist allies. His comments came during a public exchange of criticisms with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) regarding the latter’s presidential campaign.
